provenance.known_at_limitation: retrospective official dump has observation dates and acquisition hash, but no per-bar historical vintage timestamp

replay.determinism_method: canonical stream reread plus fixed sample evaluator double-pass

frequency_diagnostics.rule: daily frequency > mean + 3 population standard deviations; descriptive only

timing_contract.earliest_execution: next XSHG session T+1 recorded per signal date

universe_semantics: historical daily-K rows present at T with >=120 bars through T

validation_interval.selection_rationale: The original 14 dates were quarter-end common sessions plus the latest available session; the continuous extension keeps those frozen endpoints and expands only the same validation partition.
